Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Engineering (First-Year) BS at Purdue University

What Purdue University asks of applicants to Engineering (First-Year) BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Purdue University courses · Engineering field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT, ACT or CLT scores expected of applicants (no preference between tests)
  • In exceptional cases where an applicant could not take a test, the application may still be submitted
  • ACT Science section not required

Purdue admits first-year applicants into a specific major.

Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: Your Guide to Applying · Purdue: Your Guide to Applying
English language
  • International applicants whose first language is not English are evaluated for English proficiency; an exam is the most common and preferred evidence
  • Required minimum:
    • TOEFL iBT 4.5 with at least 4.0 per section (88 with 20 per section for tests before 21 Jan 2026)
    • ACT English 26 or SAT EBRW 600 also qualify
  • Scores must be from a test taken within the past two years

For the Duolingo English Test (115, subscores 110) and IELTS (6.5, 6.0 per section) Purdue states what applicants “generally” have, not a minimum, so those figures are not shown as requirements. A completed English-taught curriculum (at least three years, B or better in English) may also be considered.

Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: English Proficiency
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test is listed for this major.

Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: Your Guide to Applying
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: minimum high-school coursework — Math 4 years, English 4 years, Lab science 3 years, Social studies 3 years, World language 2 years (can be different languages); may also be met through nonremedial college-level coursework. For engineering applicants, chemistry is expected; review places particular emphasis on calculus (if available), four years of laboratory sciences including biology, chemistry (expected) and physics (if available).

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: High School Course Requirements · Purdue: Engineering (First-Year)
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
No AS- or A-Level subject requirements. Applicants who do not study beyond IGCSE/GCSE are generally not considered competitive. IGCSE/GCSE applicants need passes in at least five academic subjects including English, mathematics, a natural/physical science and a social science.

Purdue says most applicants complete three to four AS- or A-level subjects — a description of applicants, not a requirement. No A-Level grade offer is stated.

Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: International Students
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
IB students are considered with or without the full IB Diploma, provided the minimum high-school course requirements are met; HL is not preferred over SL; no overall IB minimum score; submit predicted IB scores if available.
Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: International Students
Other qualifications
  • CLT scores are accepted alongside SAT/ACT
  • Purdue advises taking available AP, IB or dual-enrollment courses

Purdue’s admissions pages checked (guide, first-year criteria, course requirements, international) do not say whether AP exam scores are used or can be self-reported for admission; AP/A-Level credit pages are about credit after enrolling.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: Your Guide to Applying · Purdue: High School Course Requirements
Other requirements
  • Applicants to engineering in West Lafayette apply to the First-Year Engineering program and choose a specialty major (e.g. Mechanical Engineering) in the second year
  • Common App essay plus Purdue’s required questions (250 words or fewer each)
  • Priority application deadline for First-Year Engineering: Nov. 1
Verified19 Oct 2026Purdue: Engineering (First-Year) · Purdue: Your Guide to Applying
